name: @w6w-apps/addevent
description: Create, search, update and delete calendar events and calendars, manage RSVP attendees and calendar subscribers, and generate "add to calendar" links with AddEvent's Calendar & Events API v2.

w6w.longDescription:
AddEvent turns a date and a title into a working "add to calendar" link — one that opens correctly in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, Office 365 and Yahoo without the caller having to know each vendor's own calendar-link format. This app covers AddEvent's Calendar & Events API v2: full CRUD on events and the calendars that hold them, RSVP attendee management for events that require a response, read access to a calendar's subscribers, and lookups of the account's saved RSVP forms, landing-page templates and supported timezones.

The shape of most workflows against this API is small: create or update an event when something happens in your own system (a booking, a webinar, a lifecycle change), and every event comes back with `link_long`/`link_short` URLs ready to hand to a user or drop in an email. RSVP-enabled events additionally track seat limits and going/maybe/not-going counts, and a workflow can react to a new RSVP attendee or read the roster of a subscribed calendar.

Health checks track AddEvent's own status page. AddEvent publishes no rate-limit or usage-quota signal of any kind — no response headers, no metering endpoint — so that question is answered as a declared absence rather than guessed at.
